arStrings.szText: Oh, is it so obvious? See, I study Firstborn artifacts. Fascinating relics, capable of wondrous, awful, incredible things.
A little embarrassed. The words "Wondrous, awful, and incredible" are said with the same level of eagerness.

One of these artifacts, which I’ve named the Tear of the Firstborn, was discovered in Nahantu. I arranged to have it sent on Captain Migoso’s vessel—you’ll not find a sturdier ship, nor a finer captain.
Drollon is fond of the captain.
Yet, she has not arrived. Can you accompany me to the Lycander shoreline? I worry something has happened to her.
